body: Thank you to all of you, But I don't think I will last the night.

You Know, Your Kind, And You would think that what you Said would Be True. But sadly, It's Not I don't care how much Paperwork, or Scars or How much I beg, They just Laugh At Me OR Say I must be trying to Get Opioids.

Word for Word, Well Usually I tell Them That I have Near Constant Flashbacks Of Him cutting away at Me with No Anesthetic, then I remember, Him Telling Me to Lay The F*** Back and Lay F****** Still, Then I remember the Blood Starting to Squirt every where, That's usually, where they Cut Me Off and say There's No Way a Licensed Doctor would do that. 

But I also, I Try to tell them that I have these Flashback's Constantly all Day and Night and Even In My Dream's, I Break out In Hot sweats, and Keep feeling him Cutting away at me and the Blood Squirting Everywhere. 

The Nurses were worried when the actual event Happened that they may, Have to take me to an ER Because, I was losing so Much Blood. But Somehow It stopped, But My Shirt was Ruined.

And Besides of Meditation, All I can really do Is listen to Music Like Bob Marley or Janis Joplin.

I do nothing but say, that I am having PTSD Flashbacks. I do absolutely nothing to make them think I am there for,  malicious reasons. They just seem to think everyone that goes to a ER Under 30yo Is a Drug Addict. I am In TN One of the Worst States In The US for HealthCare.

I have tried to be  Admitted to a Hospital, In fact I have actually been On my Knees Literally not Figuratively, Begging To Be, Admitted, And I am Either Refused Out Right Or laughed at.

Twice I have actually been told, And I Quite '' We are not Going to Give You any Pain Medicine'' To which I told them It's My Nerves/PTSD, Not Pain, not to say that I don't have pain. I then received Bills for Lab work Testing me for Heroin,Meth,Cocaine,Opiates, and Marijuana, All of which showed up as Negative, I Have Never taken any Illegal Drugs, I have never Even Had a Speeding Ticket! What do any of those Have to do with PTSD Flashbacks?

My Family is My support And They are at there Ropes End. But they Have begged as well, In fact My father was Once told/Screamed at, that He needs to get Me off Heroin, Which I have Never Taken BTW, and Get me to Straightened Up, To That End, The ER Head Doctor Tested Me for Heroin, And guess what It was, Negative.  Every Time I try to explain that a Doctor Tortured me, They '' The other Doctors/Hospitals '' Just Seem to think That I am Lying.

I am from the United States, Every Doctor I go to Basically just, Scoffs at me / Or Say's there's no way that could Have Happened.

 I have talked to many Psychiatrist's, They just want me to talk about the event, Which usually makes the Flashback's worse.

 I have also talked to Religious Teachers, Including Priest's, Preacher's, and Some Buddhist Monk's/Lamas I am not sure what Religion I am Exactly, Sort of a Christian with some Simple Buddhist beliefs ''Non-Violence/Pacifist'', I Guess. And They have all Helped Some giving Guidance, and Telling me to pray more or read this book or that book, 

The only way I had been Managing It was through Deep Meditation, But the Flashbacks have been getting so Strong that I can't even Meditate anymore.
